messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Orbit launch press roundtable scheduled for tomorrow 10am PT. We need to lock EU/APAC windows, confirm quote owners, and get final fact-check items in by EOD today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alex: I can take NA press. Do we have a backup if the C-suite needs to push?
Sam: Agency on standby for media ops. Can we swap the 10:00 PT slot to 11:00? That helps EU folks join late afternoon.
Maya: 11:00 PT = 19:00 CET — fine for most reporters. @Alex any blockers with spokespeople?
Alex: Nate is out AM but can do 11:00. He wants the benchmark numbers and 2 canned quotes pre-approved.
Nate: Confirmed — I can provide 2 short quotes. Need legal sign-off on the wording though.
Olga: Send the quote drafts here now. I can sign off within 2 hours if there's no material claims. No forward-looking revenue statements.
Maya: Draft quote suggestions (quick):
```
1) "We built Orbit to reduce inference latency by up to 3x for long-context models."
2) "Our goal is to make production inference predictable and cost-efficient for engineering teams."
```
Maya: Are those OK? If not, edit inline and ping @Olga.
Sam: Agency asks for a short bulletsheet for media: one-sentence product blurb, benchmark highlights, customer quote, availability details. I'll turn it into a one-pager.
Alex: Also need a fact-check spreadsheet. Can someone drop the benchmark numbers and test config? Prefer CSV.
Nate: Dropping numbers now:
- median latency (1k tok): 120ms
- 95th pct: 300ms
- cost per 1k tok: $0.15
- model: redwood-instruct-4b (quantized)
Nate: Test config: batch=8, seq=1024, mixed-precision, KV cache enabled.
Maya: Good. @PressBot can you create a calendar invite for 11:00 PT and attach the one-pager when ready?
PressBot: Created invite: "Orbit launch — press roundtable" 1918794000, added Maya, Alex, Sam, Nate, Olga; RSVP pending.
Olga: Quick legal note — remove any absolute "up to 3x" claims unless we footnote the test conditions. Suggest: "up to 3x in internal benchmarks under X configuration."
Maya: Updated quote draft:
```
1) "In internal benchmarks, Orbit reduced inference latency by up to 3x under our long-context config (seq=1024)."
```
Maya: OK to push that to the media one-pager?
Olga: That wording is fine.
Sam: I'll finalize the one-pager and post the doc link in this thread in 30m.
Alex: Final ask — who owns on-the-record follow-up? I can take quick technical Qs, but customer references should go to GTM.
Maya: Alex owns press follow-ups. Sam will route customer reference requests to sales.
Maya: Final checklist for EOD:
- quote drafts approved by legal (Olga)
- one-pager posted (Sam)
- calendar invite + media list (PressBot/Sam)
- benchmark CSV attached (Nate)
Maya: Thanks everyone — please ping in-thread if anything slips. :rocket:
